headline: "Even the good ones aren't worth fighting over"… solo bidding becomes the norm for Mokdong and Yeouido redevelopment projects
summary: Major construction companies no longer compete for core Seoul redevelopment orders, with Mokdong and Yeouido prime projects repeatedly failing with single bidders. Several large projects are launching simultaneously.
why: Large domestic redevelopment contracts are a key revenue source for Korean construction groups, and weak bidding competition affects their margins.
